name: Death splash

v1.prompt: Cartoon comedy: a big splash of clear water drops on the cat from above. Its fur goes flat and dripping, it looks miserable and much skinnier, ears flat sideways, eyes half-closed and grumpy, face still in side view. It stays standing and gives one small shiver. Clear water with cool silver highlights; no pool, nothing covers the cat. Static camera, no zoom, pan or tilt; strict side view. Keep the exact painting style, colours, light and outline of the image. The cat stays the same size in every frame.

verdict: good with the default re-cut: drenched, grumpy, dripping; cool blue suits Reality B; tail leaves the left edge
